ns2:course.label: Water Resources Engineering
ns2:course.description: Quantitative aspects of water in the earth's environment and its engineering implications, including design and analysis of systems directly concerned with use and control of water; quantitative introduction to hydrology, hydraulic engineering, and water resources planning. Prerequisite: CEE 202; credit or concurrent registration in CEE 201.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CEE 202; credit or concurrent registration in CEE 201.
